verdict.rationale: Delegated access through agents, designees or third-party administrators is a fair question for a state unemployment-tax agency, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only employer self-registration, filing and account management (UTR, UTS, QuickFile) and documents no sanctioned third-party representative or agent rail. The vocational rehabilitation provider locator is an unrelated service and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
